# Document Info

## Summary
The document catalogue facts of a PDF: authorship, page count and version.

## Shape
`producer` and `creator` are kept separate because they answer different questions — which
application authored the content versus which wrote the PDF bytes — and they routinely disagree.
`pageCount` is what lets a fitted card state a document's size without opening it, and `encrypted`
records when the catalogue is readable but the content stream is not. Consumed by
`PdfDef.documentInfo`.

## Example
```ts
import { DocumentInfoField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(DocumentInfoField);
```
